correctness.rationale: For iid area-uniform points on a fixed hemisphere, the derived single-edge distance density (1-a/pi)sin(a) gives mean 4/pi and second moment 2. Conditional on common vertex, covariance is Var(m(X)); the odd Legendre series and hemisphere addition theorem give exact nonnegative central-binomial series and gamma=0.027187049620..., with independent quadrature reconstruction agreeing within 5e-10. Thus n-cycle has exactly n adjacent pairs and variance n*(2-16/pi²+2gamma) for all n>=3, n=3 included. Bounded stationary one-dependent edge variables satisfy the classical CLT; closing changes one edge by at most pi. Series tail bound follows c_k<=1/sqrt(k+1). Neither simulation nor 1-d quadrature alone proves general result.
